defect.description: The setting is read as settings['FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE'] or False instead of settings.getbool(...): command-line overrides arrive as text, so -s FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE=False (or =0) gives the non-empty string 'False', which is truthy and turns active mode on.

review_items: feedstorage.py:27 — `or False` treats CLI string "False" as truthy; use getbool
test only covers native True, not the CLI string path; add from_command_line test
store() lacks try/finally, so the FTP connection leaks on error (pre-existing)
votes.evidence_quote: `settings["FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE"] or False` treats CLI string `"False"` as truthy.
votes.justification: The review points to the exact line in from_settings. It explains that CLI overrides arrive as strings, so "False" is truthy and turns active mode on, and it recommends settings.getbool. That is the same defect with the same cause.
